content:
It might not be Black Friday yet, but we’re still seeing incredible deals leading up to the year’s best sale period. Whether you’re looking for a controller for your Xbox or PS5, a LEGO set to gift over the holidays, or new video games to play during those long winter nights, there’s a deal for you today. You can even save on almost all the popular streaming platforms, so you can catch up on all the latest and greatest TV shows and movies.

TL;DR - The Best Deals for November 25

Take a look at all of today’s top deals and find out more below:

$49 Heart Breaker Special Edition Xbox Wireless Controller

The Heart Breaker Special Edition Xbox Wireless Controller is down to its lowest price ever during Xbox’s Black Friday Sale. The Breaker series of controllers features bold, striking designs that really stand out, and the pink, blue, and purple accents on the Heart Breaker are my personal favorite. At its core is the classic Xbox Wireless Controller, which also makes a fantastic PC controller, with the familiar, comfortable design and consistently reliable performance. Read IGN’s full review to learn more.

Looking for more Xbox Wireless Controller deals? Check them out below:

Resident Evil Requiem for PS5 Is $30

Resident Evil Requiem for PS5 is just $30 at Walmart. This survival horror game that just dropped in February is full of all the gore, puzzles, and incredible boss fights you've come to expect from the iconic series. Earning a 9/10 in IGN’s review, Tristan Ogilvie said: “From my first trembling steps into its shadows all the way to the tremendous, titan-sized takedown at its climax, Resident Evil Requiem kept me completely absorbed and consistently entertained whether it was all hair-raising or all guns blazing.”

Check out more incredible discounts during Walmart’s Black Friday Sale below:

$18 Apple AirTag (2nd Gen)

A single Apple AirTag has dropped to its lowest price yet for Black Friday. For just $18, you get a handy little tracking device you can place in luggage, on keys, or even on a pet. The AirTag pairs easily with an iPhone or iPad and connects seamlessly with Apple’s Find My app. Location sharing even lets your family and friends track certain items, too. This newest generation features improved precision finding, a louder speaker, the ability to ping from farther away, and more. As someone who constantly misplaces things, AirTags are a lifesaver and make a great stocking stuffer.

Hatchin' Yoshi Drops to New Low Price

Hatchin' Yoshi from The Super Mario Galaxy Movie has dropped to a new low price on a Black Friday lightning deal, so act fast. This interactive toy has Yoshi break out of its shell. Afterward, you can interact with Yoshi and watch his reactions. If you’re looking to display Yoshi, you can even use the bottom part of the cracked egg as a stand.

Peacock and More Black Friday Streaming Deals

The best Black Friday streaming deals are live, and all the discounts are pretty significant if you’ve been looking to add a few more platforms to your lineup. Peacock’s Black Friday discount is particularly great. You can get 12 months of the Select plan for just $29.99, saving $60. While ad-supported, it gives you access to NBC’s sitcom vault, including The Office and Parks and Rec. You can also get three months of Peacock Select for $2.99 per month instead of the usual $8.99 per month.

See all the Black Friday Streaming deals below:

Get 44% Off LEGO Succulents

I can’t keep a succulent alive for the life of me, but this LEGO Succulent set is basically impossible to kill. Right now, you can grab it for one of the lowest prices I’ve seen: $27.99. It includes 9 different plants in their own little planters, which can be placed together or separated. They’ll look adorable on a desk or bookshelf and will never require any watering, just an occasional dusting.

Check out even more Black Friday LEGO deals below:

$9.99 Christmas 4K Blu-rays

Get in the holiday spirit with $9.99 Christmas 4K Blu-rays. I love to rewatch tons of films, and Christmas movies always get the most playtime this time of year. Having physical copies rather than relying on streaming is so convenient. If you don’t already have these films in your collection, now’s the time. Classics like Elf, National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation, and A Christmas Story are all just $10 for a limited time. Check out the entire sale here.

HyperX OMEN RTX 5070 Gaming Laptop for $1,299

If you want a super-capable gaming laptop for an incredibly low price, grab the HP HyperX OMEN RTX 5070 for just $1,299 at Walmart for Black Friday. That GPU pairs with the 2.5K IPS display, which hits up to 180fps, and the AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX CPU. Rounding out this laptop is 16GB of DDR5 RAM and a 1TB SSD.

$40 PS5 DualSense Controller

A grade-A refurbished PlayStation 5 DualSense Wireless Controller is only $39.99 on Woot, and Amazon Prime members get free shipping. Just the classic white colorway is discounted, but it has everything you need in a PS5 controller. Adaptive triggers, haptic feedback, a familiar layout, and consistently reliable performance will always leave you reaching for this controller.

If you’re after a controller with a bit more pizzazz, PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale has discounted plenty of other DualSense controllers; check those deals out below:

MTG x Marvel Super Heroes Play Booster Box Hits New Low Price on Amazon

The MTG x Marvel Super Heroes Play Booster Box has dropped to a new low price, and it’s shipped and sold by Amazon for added peace of mind. The box contains 30 Play Booster packs, bringing the price per pack to $3.50. Each Play Booster pack has 14 cards, featuring at least 1 shiny traditional foil card, along with 1 to 4 cards of rarity. If you’re looking to build out your Marvel Super Heroes deck, the Play Booster Box is great to grab.

Talix 20,000mAh 140W Power Bank for $36

Give the gift of a charge with the Talix 20,000 140W Power Bank for just $35.99 with coupon code “7FD9RN0U” at checkout. This Lenovo-backed company’s power bank features a unique window that displays the circuitry inside. With a max output of 140W on one USB-C port, it's powerful enough to charge non-gaming laptops, handheld gaming PCs, and the Switch 2. Its other two outputs include a 65W USB-C port and a 30W USB-A port. Plus, there’s a generous 20,000mAh (74Whr) battery capacity.

$15 PS5 Physical Game Deals

For Black Friday, select PS5 game discs are on sale for just $15. Some of the games aren’t even that old. Highlights include Mafia: The Old Country, Assassin’s Creed Shadows, and the 2022 Game of the Year Winner, Elden Ring. Borderlands 4 is even $15. This addictive looter shooter is sure to be a blast, offering a long main story and an incredible co-op experience, making it a great value. In IGN’s review, Travis Northup said: “Borderlands 4 gives the series the massive kick in the pants it has needed, with a fantastic open world and greatly improved combat.”

See the other top $15 PS5 game deals below:

Beats Studio Pro Headphones Under $100

The Beats Studio Pro Headphones are down to the lowest price I’ve seen during Walmart’s Black Friday Sale. For under $100, you get headphones that deliver a top-tier sound performance, solid active noise cancellation, and an incredible 40-hour battery life. A bunch of Apple features are also available, including a seamless, simple connection to Apple devices, spatial audio with head tracking, and "Find My" functionality, at a fraction of the cost of the AirPods Max.

$50 Off Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle

You can save $50 on the Switch 2 bundle during Nintendo’s Black Friday sale. With this bundle, you get Mario Kart World and a three-month membership to Nintendo Switch Online. Normally, this bundle would save about $38, but thanks to Black Friday pricing, you save around $88. Now, this is likely the only major Switch 2 deal you’ll find for Black Friday, so grab it while you can.

Apple AirPods Pro 3 Drop to New Low Price

The AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to the lowest price yet for Black Friday. Apple’s highest-end earbuds offer improved noise cancellation and sound quality from its predecessor. This model also brings a longer battery life, a higher waterproof rating, and a new heart-rate-sensing monitor. Of course, all the quality-of-life features you love, like a comfortable fit and seamless connection with Apple devices, come standard.

Alienware Aurora R16 RTX 5070 for $1,899.97

Now’s the best time of year to save on a new rig, with plenty of noteworthy Black Friday gaming PC deals. One highlight is the Alienware Aurora R16 RTX 5070, down to $1,899.97 for a limited time. The same configuration is going for $800 more at Dell. Rocking a GeForce RTX 5070 GPU, this PC excels at 1080p and 1440p gaming and can even tackle some 4K action. That graphics card is paired with an air-cooled Intel Core Ultra 7 265F CPU, 32GB of DDR5-5200MHz RAM, and a 1TB SSD.

Check out more Black Friday gaming PC deals below:

$20 Off Donkey Kong Bananza

A physical copy of Donkey Kong Bananza is $20 off during Nintendo’s Black Friday sale, and you may be able to get a digital edition even cheaper if Walmart restocks it for only $30. This 2025 Game of the Year runner-up rarely gets discounted and earned an “Amazing” 10/10 rating in IGN’s review. Reviewer Logan Plant found, “Donkey Kong Bananza is a truly groundbreaking 3D platformer, with satisfying movement, powerful abilities, impressive destructible environments, and clever challenges that all come together in complete harmony to create Nintendo’s first Switch 2 masterpiece.”

See even more Black Friday Switch 2 game deals below:
